paragraphs: Rav Tavot: Chullin 44a; there, 49b, Tavit. Some say Rav Tavyomi: even if given the whole expanse of the world, he would not change his word—Chelek, Sanhedrin 97a. Bava Metzia 49a, near the end: some say his name was Rav Shmuel bar Zutra. Beer Sheva, 92b, writes: “I think this is a scribal error and should read: some say Rav Tavyomi.” He said to Ravina: there, HaZahav. In Shmuel's name: Midrash Shmuel, chapter 25 in the checked edition. It must be that this Ravina is the earlier one, since much time separates Shmuel and the later Ravina; alternatively, Rav Tavot lived that very long.
